subodhi.p: [ su + bodhi= budha + i ] (thī, pu) Google Translate (Lottery) (1) Good-intelligence-Arhatmaj and omniscience. (P) (2) well-informed; he.

DOP: bodhi f. , m., and mfn. [ BHS id. ], ( acc. bodhiṃ, bodhiyaṃ; gen. ~iyā, ~ino, ~issa; see also Sadd 201, 17 foll. , 251, 21 foll. ), Abh 805; Ps I 54, 25 (~ī ti rukkho pi ariyamaggo pi sabbaññutañāṇaṃ pi nibbānaṃ pi); Bv-a 145, 35* foll. (magge phale ca nibbāne rukkhe paṇṇattiyaṃ tathā sabbaññute ca ñāṇasmiṃ bodhisaddo pan’ āgato) ≠ Sadd 482, 19* foll.; 1. ( f.m. ) ( i ) the supreme understanding by which a man becomes a buddha; the understanding of the true nature of the world of experience, of saṃsāra and the way to release from it; the omniscience of a buddha; D II 115, 13 (saddahasi tvaṃ Ānanda tathāgatassa ~in ti); M I 356, 3 (saddahati tathāgatassa ~iṃ, iti pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho …); S I 196, 16* (bahunnaṃ vata atthāya ~iṃ ajjhagamā muni); Vv 81:24 (saddaṃ sutvāna ~iyā; Vv-a 317, 2 : patto sambodhiṃ uttaman ti paṭhamataraṃ °-saddaṃ sutvā); Ja I 44, 29* (~iyā niyatā narā); 67, 21 (rājā nāhaṃ saddahāmi, mama puttassa ~iṃ appatvā kālakiriyā nāma natthī ti paṭikkhipati); II 34, 14* (nam’ atthu buddhānaṃ nam’ atthu ~iyā; 35, 2´ : catusu maggesu catusu phalesu ñāṇasaṅkhātāya ~iyā atthu); III 499, 3 (ujjhitasaccā … ~iṃ pāpuṇituṃ na sakkonti); Nidd I 456, 9 (~i vuccati catūsu maggesu ñāṇaṃ paññā …); Ap 588, 22 (pāpuṇissati ~iyaṃ); Bv-a 8, 6 (bodhisatto ~iṃ appatvā va imaṃ pallaṅkaṃ na bhindissāmī ti); 59, 15 (~ī ti sammāsambodhi arahattamaggañāṇassa ca sabbaññutañāṇassa ca etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); Cp 1:8:15 (cittassa aññathā natthi ~iyā yeva kāraṇā; Cp-a 72, 7 : sabbaññutañāṇass’ eva hetū ti attho); Mil 285, 13 (aparipakkāya ~iyā Gotamo bodhisatto nekkhammaṃ abhinikkhanto); Sp 229, 21 (bodhipakkhikānan ti ~issa pakkhe bhavānaṃ); Sadd 481, 26 (budha avagamane: … bodho ~i); — ifc see pacceka-, pacchima-, paṭhama-, majjhima-; — ( ii ) that understanding gained by an arhat; Thī 432 (pāpuṇa ~iṃ ca aggadhammaṃ ca; Thī-a 248, 1 : saccābhisambodhiṃ, maggañāṇan ti attho); Ja III 354, 19´ (sappaññā ti buddhā ca buddhasāvakā ca ~iyā paṭipannā); Ap 228, 3 (~iṃ sampajja me tuvaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se ~i; Ap-a 469, 23 : mayhaṃ sāvakabodhiṃ tuvaṃ sampajja nipphādehī ti attho); Vism 116, 21 (tissannaṃ ~īnaṃ aññataraṃ pāpuṇāti); Ps I 83, 13 (yā hi ayaṃ dhammasāmaggī yāya … ariyasāvako bujjhatī ti katvā ~ī ti vuccati); Nidd-a I 454, 22 (taṃ catumaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṃ ~iṃ bujjhitukāmassa); — 2. ( m. ) the tree under which a buddha attains supreme understanding; a tree in a vihāra (representing the Buddha’ s tree); Abh 551 (assattho ~i); Vin I 8, 11 (antarā ca Gayaṃ antarā ca ~iṃ); Ja I 16, 16* (~i tassa bhagavato assattho ti pavuccati); II 321, 12 (therena hi Jetavanadvārakoṭṭhake ~issa ropitabhāvo, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ~ino); IV 228, 28 (ahaṃ Jetavanadvāre ~iṃ ropessāmi mahābodhito me pakkaṃ āharathā ti); Ap 79, 2 (Vipassissa bhagavato ~iyā pāda-m-uttame); Mil 193, 24 (pubbe va bodhisattānaṃ … ~i niyatā hoti); Vism 299, 34 (cetiyaṃ vā ~iṃ vā … vandamāno); Sp 90, 22 (amhākaṃ pi bhagavato … ~inā idha patiṭṭhātabbaṃ); Sv 416, 30 (yassa yassa rukkhassa mūle catumaggañāṇasaṅkhātaṃ ~iṃ buddhā paṭivijjhanti so so ~ī ti vuccati); 582, 21 (cetiyaṅgaṇaṃ sammajjantā āsanāni dhovantā ~imhi udakaṃ āsiñcantā); Mp II 6, 22 (ye parinibbute tathāgate cetiyaṃ bhindanti ~iṃ chindanti dhātumhi upakkamanti); 317, 18 (mātāpitusu pi cetiye pi ~imhi pi pabbajitesu pi aparajjhitvā); Mhv 30:70; — 3. ( mfn. ) one who has gained understanding; Ps I 83, 20 (yo p’ esa … etāya dhammasāmaggiyā bujjhatī ti katvā ariyasāvako ~ī ti vuccati, tassa ~issa aṅgo ti pi bojjhaṅgo) = Ud-a 145, 26 foll.; Thī-a 27, 1 (~issa vā bujjhanakassa … puggalassa); — °- ghara , n. , the shelter for the bodhi tree; Ap 401, 12 (~aṃ akārayiṃ); Sp 1167, 9 (anāvāso cetiyagharaṃ ~aṃ); Ps IV 111, 14 (yā pana °-sākhā ~aṃ bādhati); Dhp-a III 215, 14 ; Ap-a 443, 12 (sakale ~e sudhālepanaṃ katvā); Mhv 37:15; — °- cariyā , f. , the practice of a bodhisatta towards bodhi; Ps II 289, 33 (mayhaṃ aparipakke ñāṇe ~aṃ carantassa); Cp-a 19, 35 (bodhisattacaritaṃ °-sambhārā ~ā aggayānaṃ pāramiyo ti atthato ekaṃ vyañjanam eva nānā); — °- pakkhiya , °-pakkhika ( and sometimes, in Ce, Ee ,, bodhapakkhiya, bodhapakkhika), mfn. [bodhi + pakkhiya 2 , pakkhika 2 ; BHS bodhipakṣya, -pakṣika, -pākṣika], associated with, contributing to , bodhi; see R.M.L. Gethin, 2001; Vin III 23, 17 (°-pakkhikānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogaṃ anuyuttā vihareyyāma; Sp 229, 21 foll.: bodhissa pakkhe bhavānaṃ, arahattamaggañāṇassa upakārakānan ti attho) ≠ A III 70, 12 ( Ee, Se so; Be ~ānaṃ; Ce bodhapakkhiyānaṃ) = 301, 12 ( Be, Se ~ānaṃ; Ce bodhapakkhiyānaṃ; Ee bodhapakkhikānaṃ); D III 97, 8 (sattannaṃ ~ānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanaṃ anvāya diṭṭhe va dhamme parinibbāyati); S V 227, 19 foll. (katame ca bhikkhave ~ā dhammā) = 237, 24 ( Be, Se so; Ce °-pakkhikā; Ee bodhapakkhikā) ≠ Vibh 249, 38 ( Ce so; Be, Ee, Se °-pakkhikā); Th 900 (tassa dhammā ime honti kusalā °-pakkhikā); Ja III 450, 13 (~ānaṃ dhammānaṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee bodha-); Paṭis I 173, 9 (kusalā ~ā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr byādhipakkhiyā); Ap 28, 24 (dhammaṃ desesi … kevalaṃ ~aṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee, Se °-pakkhikaṃ); Peṭ 114, 17 (°-pakkhikā); 138, 21 (~ā); Mil 300, 14 (kusalā ~ā dhammā, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bodha-); Vism 670, 29 (sattatiṃsa ~ā); It-a II 73, 32 foll. (bujjhanaṭṭhena bodhī ti laddhanāmassa ariyapuggalassa maggañāṇass’ eva pakkhe bhavānaṃ ~ānaṃ, °-koṭṭhāsiyānan ti attho, °-pakkhikānan ti pi pāṭho, °-pakkhavantānaṃ °-pakkhe vā niyuttānan ti attho); Paṭis-a 569, 8 (~ā dhammā ti cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañc’ indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjhaṅgā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo ti); — °- pācana , mfn. [bodhi + pācana 1 ], developing bodhi; Bv 2:120 (ye dhammā ~ā); Cp 1:1:1; Bv-a 113, 19 (bodhisattehi paripūretabbā ~ā buddhattakarā dhammā, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee °-paripācanā buddhakārakā); Cp-a 17, 13 ; — °- maṇḍa , n. [ BHS id. ], the area below the bodhi tree where the bodhisatta gained complete understanding; Bv 2:64; 2:182 (sambuddhā ~amhi bujjhare); Mp I 100, 7 (~ā isipatanaṃ āgamma); Dhp-a III 61, 7 (mayā esa bhikkhave peto ~e yeva diṭṭho); — °- ma(t) , mfn. , having understanding; Spk II 21, 4 (°-mā satto bodhisatto, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee bodhiyā); — °- vaṃsa , m. , see mahābodhivaṃsa ( sv maha[t] ); — °- satta , m. , see sv; — subodhi , f. , excellent understanding; M III 69, 26* (ye … paccekam ev’ ajjhagamuṃ ~iṃ); — see also bojjhaṅga.
